$comment: Settings for the programme automations (AUTO-03, AUTO-04, AUTO-10). No token beyond the workflow's own: they write labels on these repositories' issues (fields.ts). technicalIntegrationLead is the GitHub login AUTO-10 accepts confirmations from (section 11: a setting, not hard-coded); null means the repository's own permissions decide: its owner, members and collaborators (owner, 2026-10-20). typeSource is `label` in the litlfred staging copy (type: labels) and `issue-type` in the WHO build.
